edges.reason: Lime stained glass is in the north wing glass gallery, only reachable by navigating past the diorite stairs around the corridor turn
Green stained glass panes are in the same north wing gallery as lime glass, past the diorite stairs landmark
Lapis ore wall is deeper in the east wing corridor, only reachable by navigating past the quartz slab landmark at the turn
The lapis ore forms a blocking wall at Z=7; player must mine through it to reach the potion chest and zombie pen at Z=8-12
The anvil and storage chest with items are in the west wing room, accessed by navigating past the purple carpet landmark
The anvil and map are in the same west wing room past the purple carpet
Oak leaves physically enclose the crafting table; player must mine at least one leaf block to access the table for crafting

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The diorite stairs are hidden around a 90° corridor turn at spawn-relative (-3, 0, -9), approximately 10 blocks from spawn with no direct line of sight. Max_distance=4 ensures the player actually navigated the north corridor and turned west. Facing_tolerance=60 confirms visual observation of the stairs.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The quartz slabs are hidden around the east corridor's 90° turn at spawn-relative (8, 0, 4), approximately 9 blocks from spawn with no direct LOS. Max_distance=4 ensures actual navigation past the corridor corner.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The purple carpet is hidden around the west corridor's 90° turn at spawn-relative (-8, 0, 4), approximately 9 blocks from spawn with no direct LOS. Max_distance=4 ensures actual navigation past the corridor corner.

Uses inventory_has because mining oak leaves WITH SHEARS (provided in starting inventory) causes the leaf block to drop as a collectible item. The leaves enclose the crafting table at (0,0,7); mining them is required to access the table. Only shears yield the oak_leaves item — this is the expected tool since it's provided.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because lime stained glass drops NOTHING when mined without silk touch (player has iron pickaxe without silk touch). Cannot use inventory_has. Verifies block destruction: originally 3 blocks placed at spawn-relative (-6 to -8, 1, -14). If at most 2 remain in the generous gallery box, at least 1 was successfully destroyed.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because green stained glass pane drops NOTHING when mined without silk touch. Verifies block destruction: originally 3 panes placed at spawn-relative (-6 to -8, 2, -14). If at most 2 remain in the generous gallery box, at least 1 was successfully destroyed.

Uses inventory_has because mining lapis ore with iron pickaxe (no silk touch) drops lapis_lazuli items into inventory. The ore wall at spawn-relative (8-10, 0-2, 7) physically blocks passage to the potion chest and zombie pen. Player must mine through it, yielding lapis_lazuli. Checks for lapis_lazuli (not lapis_ore) to correctly account for non-silk-touch drop behavior.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted wooden sword ends up in the player's inventory. Player must mine oak logs from the tree at (0, 0-2, 6), craft planks, craft sticks, then craft the sword at the crafting table (0, 0, 7) accessible only after mining enclosing leaves. The wooden_sword appearing in inventory confirms the full crafting chain.

Uses inventory_has because the chest item ends up in the player's inventory after retrieval from the storage chest at (-12, 0, 5) and anvil interaction at (-12, 0, 6). While we cannot verify the custom name with available rule types, the chest item is ONLY obtainable from the storage chest in the anvil room (requires navigating west corridor past purple carpet). This is the best available verification given supported rule types.

Uses inventory_has because the filled_map ends up in the player's inventory after retrieval from the storage chest at (-12, 0, 5) and anvil interaction. The filled_map is ONLY obtainable from the storage chest in the anvil room. Same acknowledged limitation as rename chest — verifies item possession as best available proxy for renaming.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the splash potion is consumed on use (leaves no inventory trace) and doesn't kill the zombie (only slows it). The zombie is at spawn-relative (11, 1, 10) in a fenced pen that is ONLY reachable after mining through the lapis ore wall (enforced by dependency chain). Max_distance=5 matches splash potion throwing range. The player must be near the zombie and facing it, which combined with the physical access constraint (lapis wall) provides reasonable verification that the potion was obtained and used.

scene_description: A corridor-based structure where the player spawns in a central 5x5 room. Three corridors branch off with 90-degree turns, hiding landmarks from direct line of sight. North corridor turns west to reveal diorite stairs and the glass gallery. East corridor turns south to reveal quartz slabs and the mining chamber (lapis ore wall blocks passage to potion chest and zombie). West corridor turns south to reveal purple carpet and the renaming station. South corridor leads to an oak tree area where leaves completely enclose the crafting table. A NoAI zombie is penned in the east back room for the splash potion target.
task_text: Navigate a corridor complex to find hidden landmarks (diorite stairs, quartz slab, purple carpet), mine various blocks (oak leaves, lime stained glass, green stained glass pane, lapis ore), craft a wooden sword, rename a chest and map at an anvil, and use a splash potion of slowness on a trapped zombie.
design_notes: FINAL APPROVED LAYOUT with zombie spawn fix applied. Central 5x5 spawn room at origin. North corridor (Z=-3 to -8) turns west (X=-1 to -8, Z=-8 to -10) — diorite stairs at (-3,0,-8/-9/-10), glass gallery at (-6 to -8, 1-2, -14). East corridor (X=3 to 8) turns south (X=8-10, Z=1 to 8) — quartz slabs at (8,0,3/4/5), full lapis ore wall at (8-10, 0-2, 7), back room at (8-12, 0, 8-12) with potion chest at (10,0,10) and zombie pen. West corridor (X=-3 to -8) turns south (X=-8 to -10, Z=1 to 8) — purple carpet at (-8,0,3/4/5), anvil room at (-10 to -13, 0, 4-8) with anvil at (-12,0,6) and storage chest at (-12,0,5). South corridor (Z=3 to 8) — oak tree at (0, 0-2, 6), crafting table at (0,0,7) fully enclosed by 14 leaf blocks. Player given iron pickaxe, shears, 30 XP levels. ZOMBIE FIX: Summon at (11,1,10) in cleared air space, NOT at (12,1,10) where fence exists.
